scope_note: Evidence-first synthesis of the ten supplied, independently researched ERP reviews only. Scores are provisional and class-sensitive; no score, repository, release or public availability implies adoption approval, production readiness, security assurance, certification, legal clearance or commercial reuse authorization.

records.name: ERPNext
records.fit_limitations: Strong native finance/accounting, purchasing, stock, replenishment, warehouse, fulfillment and manufacturing/BOM/work-order/QC/WIP coverage. Employee/payroll coverage is evidenced, but expanded HCM should be assessed separately through Frappe HR; local statutory accounting remains to validate.
records.license_caveats: ERPNext repository and official licensing page identify GPL-3.0; documentation is CC-BY-SA-3.0 and marks are separately trademarked. Pricing material contains conflicting AGPL-3.0 self-hosting wording; counsel must resolve the applicable component/service boundary.
records.maintenance_security: Active release history includes v16.35.0; upstream support pages plan v15 through end-2027 and v16 through end-2029, subject to change. Responsible-disclosure route exists, but no independent audit, comprehensive advisory disposition or complete runtime/container supply-chain review was established. Pin a supported compatible Frappe/ERPNext stack.
records.interoperability: Frappe documents generated REST CRUD endpoints for DocTypes, whitelisted Python calls, token/password and OAuth authentication, plus integration categories for commerce, payments, shipping, banking, Google and backup. Individual connector maintenance, compatibility and terms require validation.
records.arabic_rtl: Translation extraction/CSV workflow and language contributions are documented, but Arabic completeness and end-to-end RTL/bidi behavior are not established. Acceptance-test Arabic core screens, reports, print formats and mixed Arabic/Latin content.
records.recommendation_rationale: gate on GPL/legal and AGPL wording/trademark review, pinned-stack security/dependency review, statutory/workflow validation, and Arabic/RTL hands-on testing; do not treat as blanket production approval.

records.name: Odoo Community
records.category: Open-core modular ERP with edition boundaries
records.fit_limitations: First-party Community modules substantiate invoicing/accounting baseline, purchasing, inventory/warehouse and manufacturing. Community HR-related modules exist, but the evidence does not establish Community payroll or country-specific statutory parity; map every required workflow and connector to an exact module and edition.
records.license_caveats: Repository and inspected account, purchase, stock, MRP and HR manifests identify LGPL-3; third-party components can have other terms. Enterprise is a separate repository of add-ons, while hosting plans and API access have commercial boundaries; public source is not blanket commercial clearance.
records.maintenance_security: Official installation documentation identifies the 19.0 branch; branch activity was observed at the checked date, with no packaged GitHub releases. Odoo publishes security guidance, but comprehensive current advisory/dependency disposition was not independently verified. Production hardening, patching and dependency scanning remain required.
records.interoperability: Odoo 19 documents JSON-2 over HTTP, but external API access is restricted to Custom plans and XML-RPC/JSON-RPC are scheduled for removal in Odoo 22. Payment, carrier, localization and other connectors may be separate modules or services.
records.arabic_rtl: Official language selection and Arabic-region localization evidence do not establish Arabic UI completeness or RTL behavior. Acceptance-test core screens, reports, documents and custom modules in Arabic.
records.recommendation_rationale: conditional on scoped proof of concept, Community/Enterprise and dependency-license mapping, security and backup/restore review, jurisdiction-specific accounting/payroll review, and Arabic/RTL acceptance testing.

records.name: Dolibarr
records.fit_limitations: Native coverage includes invoices/payments, banking, procurement, stock/lots/serials, BOM/manufacturing orders, employee/leave/expenses/recruitment and HRM. Payroll is explicitly unsupported; advanced finite-capacity planning is not established; simplified accounting has limitations and multi-company requires an external module.
records.license_caveats: Core is GPL-3+; included dependencies have other licenses. Paid hosting and marketplace modules are commercial offers distinct from core; review dependency and add-on licensing for the intended deployment.
records.maintenance_security: Canonical release activity showed v24.0.1 and a v24 announcement at the checked date, but precise supported-branch policy/cadence was not independently established. Security policy exists, yet reporting is routed through issues/email and a full current dependency/SBOM audit was not established.
records.interoperability: Documented REST API supports explorer/Swagger, per-user API key headers and GET/POST/PUT/DELETE; webhooks, LDAP, OAuth, payment, IMAP/email and calendar interfaces are module-dependent. SOAP is deprecated and Zapier was marked in development.
records.arabic_rtl: ar_SA locale resources and translation documentation demonstrate locale presence only. Arabic completeness and RTL visual behavior across UI, PDF/ODT and modules require native-speaker acceptance testing.
records.recommendation_rationale: bounded proof of concept required for finance/manufacturing workflows, Arabic RTL output, jurisdictional fit, security/dependencies and third-party add-on licenses; not production approval.

records.name: Tryton
records.fit_limitations: Strong accounting, procurement, operations/inventory and manufacturing coverage through selectable modules. Attendance and Timesheet do not establish full HCM/payroll; country-specific accounting, extensions and local-provider connectors require validation.
records.license_caveats: GitHub repository metadata has a null license field; module-level LICENSE files exist. Verify the license of every selected component; no edition/pricing matrix was established.
records.maintenance_security: Official materials reported September 2026 development activity and an 8.2 release planned for October 2026. Security notices include fixed template-injection and report-rendering/local-file concerns; no GitHub SECURITY.md or published advisories were detected. Pin patched versions and inspect dependencies/templates.
records.interoperability: Official sources describe RPC and REST clients and product-level bank, carrier and website integration claims; specific maintained connectors for So7ob or local providers are unverified.
records.arabic_rtl: Translation architecture and language inheritance are documented, but Arabic completeness and RTL/bidi behavior are not verified. Test actual UI, forms, reports and templates end to end.
records.recommendation_rationale: conditional on module-by-module license/legal review, patched-version and security/dependency checks, proving required HCM coverage or integration, and Arabic/RTL acceptance tests.

records.name: metasfresh
records.fit_limitations: Strong documented fit for distribution, wholesale, inventory, manufacturing, finance/accounting, logistics, payments and quality. Functional breadth does not by itself establish jurisdictional accounting, workflow depth or production configuration.
records.license_caveats: GitHub license detection returned 404 and no root LICENSE was exposed in repository contents. Obtain the applicable license, third-party notices and commercial terms before modification, network deployment or redistribution.
records.maintenance_security: Latest formal repository release is 5.175 from 2023-06-27 despite later master activity. No SECURITY.md, current independent dependency audit, SBOM, reproducible-build verification or CI health assessment was established; release/support and security maintenance need clarification.
records.interoperability: Repository and official materials describe REST, EDI shipping notifications, SEPA, Shopware 6 and RabbitMQ work. Verify API/version stability, authentication, connector ownership and add-on licensing in a POC.
records.arabic_rtl: Documentation and source evidence do not establish Arabic coverage or RTL. Test UI, forms, reports, mixed-direction content and integration workflows in Arabic.
records.recommendation_rationale: only after license/legal review, supported-release and security-maintenance clarification, current dependency assessment, deployment/upgrade validation and Arabic/RTL plus accounting-fit demonstration.

records.name: Apache OFBiz
records.fit_limitations: Official business-user material lists GL, AR/AP, billing, budgets, assets, purchasing, warehouses, lot/serialized stock, BOM/routings/MRP/costing and HR recruiting/positions/reviews/contracts/training. Ecommerce is in complementary plugins and explicitly not production-ready; plugin maturity varies.
records.license_caveats: Framework is Apache License 2.0. Plugins, dependencies and notices still require review; no Enterprise/hosted feature matrix was established.
records.maintenance_security: Latest stable evidence is 24.09.07 (June 2026); the 24.09 line is feature-frozen and receives bug fixes. 2026 vulnerabilities were patched in 24.09.06/.07. Project assigns deployers responsibility for host, extensions, integrations, credentials, exposure and log protection; demo/default configuration is not production.
records.interoperability: Developer documentation describes REST service definitions, generated OpenAPI, JWT-secured endpoints and import/export; business-user materials describe payment gateway, shipment and email integrations. Turnkey connector status is not established.
records.arabic_rtl: Translation-label infrastructure exists, but Arabic coverage and RTL/bidi rendering are unknown. Test UI, forms, reports, templates and mixed-script workflows.
records.recommendation_rationale: require representative workflow/statutory POC, Arabic/RTL validation, plugin production-readiness and dependency/license review, current-vulnerability adjudication and hardened deployment.

records.name: Axelor Open Suite
records.category: Low-code modular ERP with commercial edition boundaries
records.fit_limitations: Source modules and product descriptions show finance/accounting, purchasing, inventory/stock, supply chain, production/manufacturing and human resources. Module availability, workflow depth and commercial-only features require edition-by-edition mapping.
records.license_caveats: Source LICENSE identifies AGPLv3 while GitHub metadata reports Other/NOASSERTION. Axelor Pro and Enterprise editions are separately commercial with restrictions on redistribution; do not presume commercial features are in the public repository. The originally declared axelor/open-suite URL does not exist; canonical identity is axelor/axelor-open-suite.
records.maintenance_security: Latest release evidence identifies v9.1.9 published 2026-10-01; repository is active and not archived. SECURITY.md supplies a reporting route, but no vulnerability scan, complete transitive SBOM, security audit or certification was performed.
records.interoperability: Official documentation advertises technical/API and Axelor Connect documentation, but retrieved evidence did not establish detailed endpoint contracts or connectors suitable for a specific integration. Validate interfaces and edition availability.
records.arabic_rtl: Multilingual infrastructure and English/French resources do not establish Arabic coverage or RTL/bidi behavior. Test core and extension forms, reports and templates with Arabic content.
records.recommendation_rationale: gate on correct repository identity, edition-by-edition feature/license confirmation, supported-runtime and deployment validation, dependency/security review and Arabic/RTL acceptance testing.

records.name: iDempiere
records.fit_limitations: Strong accounting foundation with modular procurement and supply-chain scope. Current first-party evidence does not establish comprehensive core manufacturing, human-capital, Arabic or RTL coverage; prove each required module and workflow.
records.license_caveats: Canonical repository includes GPLv2. No distinct official Enterprise edition/pricing boundary was verified; REST Web Services are a separately maintained GPLv2 extension. Review dependencies and extension licenses with counsel.
records.maintenance_security: Same-day activity was observed at the checked date and SECURITY.md marks release-13 and master/a.k.a. 14 supported; GitHub Releases has no packaged latest release. No current advisory inventory, independent audit, dependency scan or SBOM was established. Pin a supported branch and assess security before deployment.
records.interoperability: Official REST Web Services page documents a production-used service maintained separately by BX Service GmbH, with support through release 12 and master. This is an extension surface, not proof all APIs are core-bundled.
records.arabic_rtl: Translation documentation exists, but Arabic coverage and end-to-end RTL/bidi behavior were not verified. Require Arabic UI, forms, reports and mixed-direction acceptance tests.
records.recommendation_rationale: conditional on module-specific workflow validation, Arabic/RTL verification, release pinning, dependency/security review, GPL/extension license review, deployment rehearsal and financial-controls review.

records.name: ADempiere
records.fit_limitations: Native finance, procurement, inventory/warehouse, manufacturing and HR/payroll components are evidenced. Distinguish source modules from current maturity/support and validate jurisdiction-specific finance/payroll, workflows and Arabic RTL.
records.license_caveats: Canonical repository identifies GPL-2.0. No verified paid/Enterprise matrix or hosted-only feature boundary was found; legal review is required for modification, distribution and deployment facts.
records.maintenance_security: Latest published tag/release verified is 3.9.4.001 from 2023-12-20. A later develop-branch push does not establish current release readiness or support policy. Repository security page states no SECURITY.md; current advisory/dependency status is unverified. Require present SBOM, scan, patch and response-owner review.
records.interoperability: Official documentation describes web services; release notes cite binary-data web services, OIDC login, Discord/Telegram notifications and S3 support. Current protocols, versioning, contracts and connector support require validation.
records.arabic_rtl: Multilingual operation and Spanish/Venezuelan localization are evidenced, but Arabic translation completeness and RTL/bidi behavior are not. Test forms, reports, mixed-script content and workflows.
records.confidence: medium for identity/license/release facts; low-to-medium overall
records.recommendation_rationale: require reproducible build/deploy of the chosen commit, process and upgrade fit, current dependency/security review and ownership, GPL legal review, and Arabic RTL plus finance/payroll validation before any evaluation move.

records.name: webERP
records.fit_limitations: Strong documented finance/accounting, procurement, inventory/warehouse and manufacturing-related scope. Evidence does not establish advanced production scheduling/MES or the expansive HR claims; webSHOP and CounterLogicPOS are separate add-ons, not built-in proof.
records.license_caveats: Composer manifest declares GPL-2.0-only and README says GPLv2; root LICENSE path was not available and bundled dependency notices need confirmation. No Enterprise-only boundary or pricing schedule was verified; legal review remains required.
records.maintenance_security: Official website states v5.0.1 current, while repository README identifies v4.15.2 stable/current RC; GitHub releases are empty and recent visible commits are dated 2025-07-05. Reconcile source/release provenance. No SECURITY.md surfaced; review PHP/vendor dependencies and advisories.
records.interoperability: Manual identifies EDI and an API tutorial; manifest includes phpxmlrpc. This does not establish a modern REST API or maintained connector ecosystem. Separate webSHOP and CounterLogicPOS add-ons need independent validation.
records.arabic_rtl: Official pages claim 37 languages, UTF-8 and localized number display, but Arabic completeness and application-wide RTL/bidi behavior are unverified. Test navigation, forms, mixed-direction content and PDF/report output.
records.recommendation_rationale: only after reconciling official v5.0.1 with repository provenance, dependency/security review, workflow testing, HR and Arabic/RTL demonstration, and GPL/jurisdiction-specific finance review.
